content_markdown:
## **Official launch of the project activities**
The **kick-off meeting** of the *Edu-GArD3n – Empowering Sustainability Through Green Additive Manufacturing Education* project successfully took place on **5–6 November 2025**, in **Istanbul (Türkiye) **, hosted at the **NBUAM Research Centre, Marmara University**.
This first in-person meeting officially marked the start of the project and brought together the **project leaders and their teams**, representing all partner institutions.

## **Focus of the Kick-off Meeting**
The kick-off meeting primarily focused on establishing a **shared understanding of the project framework and objectives**, and on aligning the team on the implementation strategy for the coming months.
From a **project perspective**, the discussions addressed:
- the overall **vision, objectives, and timeline** of Edu-GArD3n;
- the definition of **roles and responsibilities** within the team;
- the review of **deliverables, milestones, and reporting procedures**;
- the initial planning of the **virtual classroom and open-access book**;
- the definition of the **communication and dissemination strategy**.

## **Beyond the Project Discussions**
In addition to the technical and organizational aspects of the project, the kick-off meeting also represented an important opportunity to strengthen collaboration among partners.
The participants had the chance to **visit the NBUAM research facilities** at Marmara University, gaining insight into ongoing research activities and available infrastructures. The meeting also fostered **networking and knowledge exchange**, allowing partners to better understand each other’s expertise and research interests.
Social moments, including a **networking dinner**, further contributed to building a strong collaborative environment and reinforcing the sense of a shared project vision.

## **Next Steps**
Following the kick-off meeting, the team will:
- Finalize the educational content structure
- Prepare the first project deliverables
- Launch the project website and communication channels
The kick-off meeting laid a solid foundation for effective collaboration and the successful implementation of the Edu-GArD3n project over the next 36 months.

*Stay tuned for further updates on project activities and outcomes.*

## **Defining the educational foundations of the project**
The *Edu-GArD3n – Empowering Sustainability Through Green Additive Manufacturing Education* project has successfully completed its **first official deliverable (D1 – Selection of educational content)**, marking an important milestone in the early implementation phase of the project.
## **What is Deliverable D1 about?**
Deliverable D1 defines the **content and scope of the educational activities** that will be developed within the Edu-GArD3n project. In particular, it establishes the conceptual and thematic framework for:
- the **virtual classroom**, and
- the **open-access book** dedicated to green and sustainable additive manufacturing.
The document represents the outcome of collaborative discussions held during the in-person kick-off meeting at Marmara University and subsequent online coordination meetings among project partners.
## **Structure of the educational content**
As defined in D1, the virtual classroom and open-access book will consist of **16 chapters**.
The selected topics cover a broad and interdisciplinary range of themes, including:
- fundamentals of additive manufacturing and bioprinting;
- green engineering principles and sustainable product design;
- life-cycle thinking, circular design, and eco-design approaches;
- sustainable materials, including polymers, ceramics, metals, hydrogels, and recycled feedstocks;
- digital tools such as AI-driven generative design, digital twins, and immersive technologies;
- policy, standards, technology transfer, and innovation governance in green additive manufacturing.
## **A collaborative effort**
The development of Deliverable D1 was carried out through a **joint effort of the Edu-GArD3n team**, with partners contributing their complementary expertise across engineering, materials science, bioengineering, sustainability assessment, and digital manufacturing.
This collaborative process ensures that the future educational outputs of the project will reflect both **academic excellence** and **practical relevance**, addressing current and emerging challenges in sustainable additive manufacturing.
## **Next steps**
Following the completion of D1, the project will move into the **content development phase**, focusing on:
- the preparation of educational materials for the virtual classroom;
- the drafting of book chapters;
- the development of digital and multimedia content to support teaching and learning activities.

*Stay tuned for further updates on project activities and outcomes.*
